chapter.heading: A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
The earth
is the Lord’s, and everything in it.The world and all its people belong to him.

For he
laid the earth’s foundation on the seasand built it on the ocean depths.

Who may
climb the mountain of the Lord?Who may stand in his holy place?

Only those
whose hands and hearts are pure,who do not worship idolsand never tell lies.

They will
receive the Lord’s blessingand have a right relationship with God their savior.

Such people
may seek youand worship in your presence, O God of Jacob. Interlude

Open up,
ancient gates!Open up, ancient doors,and let the King of glory enter.

Who is
the King of glory?The Lord, strong and mighty;the Lord, invincible in battle.

Open up,
ancient gates!Open up, ancient doors,and let the King of glory enter.

Who is
the King of glory?The Lord of Heaven’s Armies—he is the King of glory. Interlude
